name: Git credential helper
note: Depends on F12 (CLI unavailable). Additional finding gathered at HTTP level: Git-over-HTTPS is currently unusable by any client. GET /reflogqa1/qa-repo-alpha.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack answers HTTP 307 with Location: /login?redirect=... - an HTML login page - instead of the HTTP 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Basic that the Git smart-HTTP protocol requires. HTTP Basic credentials are ignored entirely (same 307 with -u user:password), so `git clone` fails with "fatal: unable to update url base from redirection".

name: Authenticated clone / pull over HTTPS
note: The unauthenticated half of the expected result holds: an anonymous clone of the private repository is refused. The authenticated half cannot succeed: the credential helper (F13) is unavailable, and the HTTPS Git endpoint never issues an authentication challenge - it 307-redirects every smart-HTTP request to the HTML login page and ignores HTTP Basic credentials. Verified with `git clone https://reflogqa1:<password>@reflog.dev/reflogqa1/qa-repo-alpha.git` -> "fatal: unable to update url base from redirection". No supported path exists today for an authenticated HTTPS read.
